int_name: N BROAD ST & W DUNCANNON AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of a median refuge and the long crossing distance across four lanes of traffic present significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street may block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: RRFB Installation
interventions.description: Add Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at this marked crossing.

result.summary: The intersection is located in a residential area with sidewalks and marked crosswalks present. However, the roadway pavement is in poor condition with significant cracking, and the crosswalk markings are starting to fade.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and patching in the roadway, particularly within the intersection and near the crosswalk, creating potential tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are beginning to fade, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repave the intersection to provide a smooth, level surface for all users and eliminate tripping hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk markings with high-visibility thermoplastic paint to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized control. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the long crossing distance across four lanes of traffic without a refuge island increases exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a central refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight nature of the road may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the distance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and lack high-visibility patterns. While vehicle traffic signals are present, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signals to assist with safe crossing timing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn, making the crossing less conspicuous to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without clear guidance on when to cross.

hazards.name: Roadway Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Significant longitudinal and transverse cracking in the asphalt may create uneven surfaces for pedestrians and cyclists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the faded transverse markings to continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.
